name: sehatsure
description: SehatSure - Health insurance decision support and hospital cost engine

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:render: npm install --include=dev && npm --prefix server install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm run build
